app_um.import.text: If you need to create users in batches, please download the Excel template for batch creation of users and fill in the contents, and import the filled Excel contents

app_um.text.disabled_user_comment: Confirm to disable the selected user?
app_um.text.create_user_home_comment: If not filled, it will be default
app_um.text.create_user_comment_comment: It can be left blank, it is used to write the fifth position of the /etc/passwd file

app_um.text.create_user_gid_comment: The gid of the user group created on the host, if not filled, the system will assign it by default
app_um.text.create_user_pass_comment: Create a password corresponding to the user
app_um.text.create_user_group_comment: If you leave it blank, it will be the default. If the user group does not exist, create the user group
